title: Benefits of New Overseas Networks and Expertise Pass to Singapore and Singaporeans
what_it_is: Benefits of New Overseas Networks and Expertise Pass to Singapore and Singaporeans

sections.label: ONE Pass multiple company employment
sections.summary: Questions ask whether ONE Pass holders can freelance, whether companies must be Singapore-based, and how the $30,000 salary is shared.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower in view that an Overseas Networks and Expertise (ONE) Pass holder is allowed to work at multiple companies (a) whether such Pass holder can work as a freelancer or must be employed by a company; (b) whether the multiple companies are required to be Singapore-based; and (c) whether the fixed monthly salary of at least $30,000 for the ONE Pass holder is shared among the multiple companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower regarding the new Overseas Networks and Expertise (ONE) Pass (a) what is the maximum number of companies that a ONE Pass holder may work for; (b) whether the minimum monthly salary of $30,000 is an aggregate of the salaries from the multiple companies that the pass holder is employed in; and (c) if so, what is the minimum salary that the pass holder must receive from each company.

sections.label: ONE Pass studies and criteria
sections.summary: Questions ask about studies on ONE Pass numbers and impact on Singaporeans, and criteria for those below the $30,000 salary threshold.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether any studies have been carried out on the number of Overseas Networks and Expertise (ONE) Passes the Ministry intends to issue particularly with regard to the impact on job opportunities for Singaporeans; and (b) what are the objective criteria set for the issuance of the ONE Pass to individuals who do not meet the $30,000 per month salary threshold.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower what is the Ministry’s consideration for exempting the top 10% of Employment Pass holders from the Fair Consideration Framework job advertising requirement and the Complementarity Assessment Framework.

sections.label: ONE Pass safeguards and fraud
sections.summary: Questions ask whether measures exist to prevent Singaporeans being disadvantaged and to prevent fraudulent ONE Pass applications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower with regard to the newly launched Overseas Networks and Expertise (ONE) Pass (a) whether there are measures in place to ensure that Singaporeans are not disadvantaged as the ONE Pass allows eligible persons to work for multiple companies in Singapore at any one time and, if so, what are they; and (b) whether measures have been taken to enhance our systems and processes to prevent fraudulent ONE pass applications from taking place and, if so, what are they.
